name: routes
sql: select position('ten287_telegram_bot_token' in pg_get_functiondef('public.postmatch_send_alert(text,text,text)'::regprocedure))>0 pm_ten287, position('ops_telegram' in pg_get_functiondef('public.postmatch_send_alert(text,text,text)'::regprocedure))>0 pm_ops, position('ten287_telegram_bot_token' in pg_get_functiondef('public.ten216_watch_send(text,text,text)'::regprocedure))>0 wd_ten287, position('ops_telegram' in pg_get_functiondef('public.ten216_watch_send(text,text,text)'::regprocedure))>0 wd_ops, (select count(*) from cron.job where jobname in ('ten270-oddspapi-postmatch-ping','ten270-oddspapi-postmatch-check','ten216-collector-watchdog') and active) jobs_active

name: send_tests
sql: select public.postmatch_send_alert('route_test','test','TEST (TEN-295 item 3) - TEN-270 post-match dispatcher alarm: this chat is now the official ops alert route. No action needed.') pm, public.ten216_watch_send('route_test','test','TEST (TEN-295 item 3) - TEN-216 collector watchdog: this chat is now the official ops alert route. No action needed.') wd

name: delivery
sql: select 'ten270' src, l.at, l.delivered, l.request_id, r.status_code, r.timed_out, r.error_msg, (r.content::jsonb->>'ok') tg_ok, (r.content::jsonb->'result'->>'message_id') tg_msg_id from public.postmatch_alert_log l left join net._http_response r on r.id=l.request_id where l.condition='route_test' union all select 'ten216', l.at, l.delivered, l.request_id, r.status_code, r.timed_out, r.error_msg, (r.content::jsonb->>'ok'), (r.content::jsonb->'result'->>'message_id') from public.ten216_watch_log l left join net._http_response r on r.id=l.request_id where l.condition='route_test'

name: wd_log_after
sql: select id, condition, kind, channel, delivered from public.ten216_watch_log order by id
